Operations for a specific object kind. Use 'fields' subcommand to explore available fields.

Usage:
  zqk object <kind> [flags]
  zqk object <kind> [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Create a new object
  delete      Delete an object by ID
  fields      List available fields for this object kind
  get         Get an object by ID
  list        List objects of a specific kind
  update      Update an existing object

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk object <kind> [command] --help" for more information about a command.
